items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks We Keep Off Our Radar
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 We’re Skeptical Of
items.summary: Stocks trading between $10 and $50 can be particularly interesting as they frequently represent businesses that have survived their early challenges. However, investors should remain vigilant as some may still have unproven business models, leaving them vulnerable to the ebbs and flows of the broader market.

items.title: VTRS Q2 Deep Dive: China Growth, Pipeline Progress, and Margin Concerns Shape Outlook
items.summary: Medication company Viatris (NASDAQ:VTRS) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 4.9% year on year to $3.76 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $14.75 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.69 per share was 15% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
